name: Pussy Cat ~Mesuneko-tachi~
source:
Main character is the biggest power in Yokohama City, president of a huge corporation. Under the glorious facade he is actually a man greedy for money and women. He receives a task from his chief to organize a special force "Pussy Cat" to perform secret missions. What's the true purpose of this mysterious unit?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是横滨市最具权势的人物，也是一家大型企业的总裁。光鲜亮丽的外表之下，他其实是个贪恋金钱与女人的男人。上司交给他一项任务：组建一支名为“母猫”的特殊部队，负责执行秘密行动。这个神秘组织的真正目的究竟是什么？

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
